source.title: WCA North American Championship 2026 Host City Announcement (December 2025)
source.content:
Dear WCA Community,

The WCA Major Championships Team (WMCT) is happy to announce that Raleigh, North Carolina, USA has been selected to host the 2026 WCA North American Championship.

<!-- break-->

This team has significant experience in organizing Major Championships, having recently organized Worlds 2025 in Seattle, Washington. The 2025 World Championship was a big step forward for the WCA in many different aspects and we are confident its success will translate into an amazing 2026 North American Championship in Raleigh.

The competition website for the 2026 North American Championship has been announced as well. You can check it out [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NAC2026).

You can view the application documents for the WCA North American Championship 2026 [here](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1s93piIP8awPkj53N2Jy2jeqRotWvQt7W?usp=drive_link)


Raleigh was the only applicant for the North American Championship.

All of the other Continental Championships were already selected and announced in previous posts, see these here: [European Championship](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/posts/wca-european-championship-2026-announcement) and [South American, Oceanic, African, Asian Championships](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/posts/wca-continental-championships-2026-host-cities-announcement-october-2025).

translation.title: 2026 年 WCA 北美锦标赛举办城市公告（2025 年 12 月）
translation.content:
各位 WCA 社区成员：

WCA 大型锦标赛组（WMCT）很高兴地宣布，美国北卡罗来纳州罗利市将举办 2026 年 WCA 北美锦标赛。

这支团队具有丰富的大型锦标赛办赛经验，近期刚在华盛顿州西雅图举办了 2025 年世锦赛。2025 年世锦赛让 WCA 在多个方面取得了进步。我们相信，这些成功经验也将帮助团队在罗利办好 2026 年北美锦标赛。

2026 年北美锦标赛的比赛页面现已公布，可在[这里](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NAC2026)查看。

2026 年 WCA 北美锦标赛的申办材料可在[这里](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1s93piIP8awPkj53N2Jy2jeqRotWvQt7W?usp=drive_link)查看。

罗利是北美锦标赛的唯一申办城市。

其余各洲锦标赛的举办地已在此前公告中确定并公布，参见：[欧洲锦标赛](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/posts/wca-european-championship-2026-announcement)及[南美洲、大洋洲、非洲、亚洲锦标赛](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/posts/wca-continental-championships-2026-host-cities-announcement-october-2025)。
